payload.explanation: Version 0.1.1 of the custom plugin periodically inspects the active Hyprland instance and live binding table, then restores all 21 keypad bindings when its terminal-binding sentinel is absent.

reference.source_description: Public plugin repository named by the journal; the exact historical commit was not recorded.

payload.effects: The plugin runs as unsandboxed shell code, probes Hyprland every two seconds, and can recreate workspace and terminal bindings after a configuration reload.
payload.rollback: Remove or disable the custom plugin, then reload Hyprland so its dynamically registered keypad bindings are absent.
payload.validation_plan: Confirm all 21 keypad bindings exist, reload Hyprland, wait longer than one probe interval, then confirm all 21 bindings and an empty compositor configuration-error report. Also test representative keys with Num Lock on and off.

activation.details: Restart the Omarchy shell once so it loads the updated service instance.
